card.law_is_about: Uniform safety requirements for constructing, operating and inspecting carbon-dioxide pipelines.
card.they_want: Adopt the ordinance promptly and accelerate permitting through nationwide procedures.
card.they_claim: Transport pipelines cross borders and traverse several German states by definition.
card.the_problem: The relevant statutory definition describes what a CO2 pipeline transports and its associated equipment; crossing a state border is not a defining condition.

correction: CO2 transport pipelines may cross national or Land borders, but crossing borders is not part of the KSpTG definition. Section3number6 defines CO2 pipelines by their transport function and associated facilities; number6a also defines a network without a multiple-Land condition. The draft incorporates that scope. Describe multi-Land routes as an important use case rather than an unavoidable defining feature of every transport pipeline.
effect: Narrows one premise for nationwide uniform permitting and inspection procedures: some projects can fall entirely within one Land. The practical case for common national rules across a connected network remains.
limits: The author may be using transport pipelines informally to mean a planned interregional backbone, rather than every pipeline within the ordinance. Such a backbone can cross several Länder. The explicit by-definition wording nevertheless overstates the relevant legal category. No claim is made that national uniformity is unnecessary, that a particular project stays inside one Land, or that CO2 infrastructure is undesirable. This is a minor supporting-premise correction, not a refutation of the central policy request. No intent is inferred.
context_and_alternatives: All three CMA pages were read by researcher C and independently by researcher A; root visually inspected physical page2 and checked the exact surrounding national-uniformity argument.

The relevant KSpTG consolidated text reports its last amendment as25November2025, before the August2026 statement. Its definitions contain no national or Land-border condition. Current retrieval is not a frozen August archive.

The currently served ministry draft has an internal8July2026 09:33 version. Other respondents refer to7July; byte identity is not authenticated. The narrow statutory-definition correction does not depend on a July drafting difference.
The policy rationale can reasonably concern an interconnected interregional backbone. That is preserved as a contextual alternative and limits severity.
materiality_explanation: Minor: an express categorical definition is inaccurate and supports the argument for uniform national procedures. Correcting it leaves the broader multi-Land-network and investment-certainty arguments intact; no numerical cost or safety conclusion changes.
direction_explanation: True narrowly: claiming every transport line necessarily crosses several states strengthens the nationwide-uniformity rationale. Correcting that premise does not reverse the policy case.

confidence.text_source_mismatch: High for the relevant statutory definition; informal backbone terminology remains a contextual alternative.
